title: A Human-in/on-the-Loop Framework for Accessible Text Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text simplification, complex word identification, and synonym acceptance through user studies, comprehension questionnaires, and usability feedback specifically involving participants with intellectual disabilities (ID).
Measuring and comparing the perceived lexical difficulty, complex word identification recall/precision, and synonym acceptance rates of older adults against other user profiles.
Analyzing the statistical impact of participants' educational backgrounds (e.g., primary or no studies vs. secondary education) on their synonym acceptance thresholds and text comprehension.
